description: Fix conversation list scrolling by refactoring the aside layout to use proper flex structure. Currently the list doesn't scroll properly. The fix uses: outer container 'flex flex-col h-full', header section 'flex-none' for search/filters, and scrolling list 'flex-1 overflow-y-auto'. Remove any overflow:hidden that blocks scroll.
steps: 1. In apps/dashboard/src/components/inbox-page.tsx, locate the conversation list <aside> element (around line 582) with className containing 'min-h-[560px] flex-col'
2. Add 'h-full' to the aside className to ensure it has a defined height for flex children to work against
3. Verify the header <div> with search and filters (around line 583) has 'flex-none' to prevent it from shrinking
4. Verify the scrolling list container <div> (around line 591) has both 'flex-1' and 'overflow-y-auto' so it takes remaining space and scrolls
5. Check that no parent elements have 'overflow-hidden' that would prevent scrolling - the main grid container should have 'overflow-hidden' but children should be able to scroll internally
acceptance_criteria: The conversation list scrolls vertically when there are more conversations than fit in the viewport
The search bar and filter buttons remain fixed at the top of the sidebar
The 'Load older conversations' button appears at the bottom of the scrollable area
Scrolling works on both desktop (lg:) and mobile views
verification: Run 'npm run typecheck' in the project root to verify TypeScript compilation
Start the dev server with 'npm run dev' and navigate to the inbox page
Create or load enough conversations to exceed the viewport height
Verify the conversation list scrolls while the header stays fixed
Test on both desktop (>1024px) and mobile (<1024px) viewport sizes
findings: Successfully fixed conversation list scrolling by adding h-full to aside and flex-none to header. The scrolling container already had flex-1 and overflow-y-auto. TypeScript compilation passed.
